input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: The warranty package meets and exceeds our fallback, and substantially meets the preferred position. §19.1 warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel and that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications. §19.2 gives a 90-day conformance warranty for each Deliverable (running from delivery or acceptance, whichever is later) and conformance of the Hosted Services — the defined Services include the hosted software — throughout the subscription term, so both the software and services durations exceed the fallback floors of 90 and 30 days. §19.4 supplies the required remedies: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and a refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, and preserves other remedies for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. §19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty, and the §19.5 disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, so it does not swallow the warranties. Minor points short of preferred wording — the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and software conformance is expressed as the subscription term rather than a stated 12 months — are noted only and are not material deviations. No redline proposed.
